name: [R3] Admin/sensitive path enumeration burst
message:
A single source produced a burst of 4xx responses against admin/sensitive endpoints — reconnaissance (Strix-style). Confirm the source is not an approved scanner; check the targeted assets' exposure and close it.

Tune: adjust the count threshold to your baseline; allowlist approved scanner IPs.

queries.name: recon_4xx
queries.query: source:(nginx OR apache OR http OR waf) @http.status_code:(401 OR 403 OR 404) @http.url_details.path:(*\/admin* OR *wp-login* OR *phpmyadmin* OR *manager\/html* OR *\/console*)
